VBO:0200028.summary: Modern dogs called American Bandogges have varied ancestry: documented crosses include English Mastiff–Pit Bull and combinations involving Great Dane and Neapolitan Mastiff. Some programs select dogs for guarding and hog-catching work; American Sentinel dates its own breeding to 2000. These working aims and line histories do not define one fixed cross or predict an individual dog’s behavior.
VBO:0200028.shortDescription: A name used for varied modern working lines and mastiff–bull-type crosses, with differing ancestry and selection aims.

sources.title: American Bandogge Mastiff — original named adult keeper accounts
sources.evidence: Named own keeper Rascal4y describes vigilant and loving family dog, command response and pursuit of trespassing varmints; named Capone5y owner reports over50 verbal and20 sign commands; Achilles4y ownkeeper reports intense highdrive and earned Sch/IPO1. Historical named accounts not current living claims, measured population temperament or uniform aptitude. Own cross histories heterogeneous; editorial fixed-cross list not adopted. Adult Rascal4/Capone5/Diesel2 captions bind own image identity. Radley juvenile/parent trait claims, highest-title ranking/aspirational future titles, medical/heat/pain/life expectancy/child and pet safety guarantees excluded.

sources.title: American Sentinel K9 — own modern program origins and roles
sources.evidence: Fresh substantive home page independently read 2026-10-06. Program records beginning2000 and selection for guardian/hog-catch roles. Used only as own modern breeding history and intended work. Oldest/best/guaranteed performance or family-safety assertions not adopted.

sources.title: American Sentinel K9 — scope of the Bandogge name
sources.evidence: Fresh substantive article independently read 2026-10-06. Author explicitly calls AmericanSentinel one of many bandog types and rejects a universal fixed-parentage definition. His polemical ancient etymology, claims about other breeders and combative ability are not adopted as facts or endorsements. Retained original Rascal/Capone accounts separately establish actual differing reported modern ancestry.
